- `Operation.labels` is a lazy `@ManyToMany` relationship through `rel_operation__label`; therefore label availability on reads is explicitly controlled by the repository’s eager-loading path ([Operation.java:48-56](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/domain/Operation.java:48)).

- **Single-item reads:** `findOneWithEagerRelationships(id)` first loads the operation with its `bankAccount`, then passes the `Optional<Operation>` to the bag-relationship loader ([OperationRepository.java:20-22](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepository.java:20), [OperationRepository.java:41-42](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepository.java:41)). The loader maps present values through a second query using `left join fetch operation.labels`; an empty `Optional` remains empty ([OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:24-27](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:24), [OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:39-46](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:39)). `GET /operations/{id}` always uses this contract ([OperationResource.java:175-179](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/web/rest/OperationResource.java:175)).

- **Unpaged list reads:** `findAllWithEagerRelationships()` loads all operations with `bankAccount`, then fetches labels for the resulting list ([OperationRepository.java:24-26](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepository.java:24), [OperationRepository.java:38-39](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepository.java:38)). The label query operates on the supplied operations and explicitly restores their original ID order before returning ([OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:49-60](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:49)).

- **Paged reads:** `findAllWithEagerRelationships(pageable)` first executes the pageable to-one query, whose separate count query counts operations, then fetches labels for only the page content ([OperationRepository.java:28-36](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepository.java:28)). The loader rebuilds a `PageImpl` with the label-loaded content while retaining the original `Pageable` and `totalElements` ([OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:29-32](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/repository/OperationRepositoryWithBagRelationshipsImpl.java:29)).

- `GET /operations` defaults `eagerload` to `true`, selecting the paged eager contract; `eagerload=false` calls ordinary `findAll(pageable)` instead ([OperationResource.java:153-166](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/main/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/web/rest/OperationResource.java:153)). Tests directly verify this routing distinction ([OperationResourceIT.java:201-215](/root/.openclaw/workspace/experiments/tmf-java-validation-20260806/jhipster-sample-app/src/test/java/io/github/jhipster/sample/web/rest/OperationResourceIT.java:201)).
